title: Uniform lower bounds for the average length of finite Pierce expansions
summary: For integers $1\leq a\leq b$, the length of the finite Pierce expansion of $a/b$ is the number of steps of the iteration $r\mapsto b\bmod r$ which starts at $a$ and ends at zero. Erdős and Shallit (1991) proved that the average of these lengths over $1\leq a\leq b$ is bounded below by a positive constant times $\log\log b$, and suggested that it is at least of order $\log b$. In this paper, we prove that the average length is at least $\sqrt{2\log b}-3(\log b)^{1/4}-11$ for every $b\geq2$.
